verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Codex integrates with GitHub, GitLab, Linear, and Slack and lets you configure per-repo tooling/setup, but there is no evidence of an engineering-lead-level permission system to selectively allow/deny which external tools or integrations the agent can access. Community comments even raise concerns about lack of sandboxing/control over file system and app access, but no counter-evidence of an actual admin control feature exists.
